visualCharacteristics.structure: full-bleed slides of a 640px cover photo with a white panel (optional eyebrow, h2, sentence, primary cta) pulled up over the photo's bottom edge; controls row under the slide with centred dots and prev/next arrows at the right
visualCharacteristics.behaviour: no autoplay, 0.5s fade, wrap-around, clickable dots, prev/next arrows, keyboard arrow keys

contentPattern: One row per slide: cell 1 image; cell 2 optional eyebrow paragraph, heading (h2), paragraph, CTA link (bold link renders as the primary button). Block JS generates dots and arrows.
